method: Shared balanced behavior cloning across modern datasets plus size/yaw/obstacle demonstrations; no new PPO in selected checkpoint
orientation_assistance: Low-level IK aligns gripper to known initial simulator object yaw; policy controls Cartesian xyz and finger opening

results.persistent: 3/3 fixed objects with all three finally settled; no between-task world/arm reset

scope: Known simple upright boxes/cylinders, finite bounded positions, sampled mass/friction/size, one fixed known obstacle; orientation handled using simulator state
limits: No arbitrary tilted objects, multi/moving/unknown-obstacle generalization, camera-based learned perception, universal reliability, or hardware validation.
